title: 光學頻率梳穩定系統~Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems
focus: f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo、f-2f 自參考與雙迴路鎖相的梳狀雷射工程~Comb engineering around f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo, f-2f self-referencing and dual-loop phase locking
summary: 以摻鉺光纖鎖模雷射為對象，從梳齒方程式與載波包絡偏移出發，建置超連續光譜、f-2f 干涉儀與 f_ceo／f_rep 兩個鎖相迴路，說明射頻與光學參考的槓桿效應、梳齒序數判定、週期滑脫與艾倫偏差評估，最後把熱漂移與致動器範圍整合成可全天候運行並可交接的頻率梳。~Taking an erbium-fibre mode-locked laser as the object, this course starts from the comb equation and the carrier-envelope offset, builds the supercontinuum, the f-2f interferometer and the two phase-locked loops for f_ceo and f_rep, explains the lever effect of RF versus optical references, mode-number determination, cycle slips and Allan-deviation evaluation, and finally integrates thermal drift and actuator ranges into a comb that runs around the clock and can be handed over.

units.anchor: 梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位~Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase
units.title: 鎖模脈衝串與頻率梳的對應~The mode-locked pulse train and its frequency comb
units.mechanism: 鎖模雷射每隔 T_rep = 1/f_rep 發出一個脈衝，時域上的週期脈衝串在頻域上就是一排間距 f_rep 的譜線。但脈衝內的載波相對於包絡每一個脈衝會滑動一個相位 Δφ_ce，因為腔內群速度與相速度不同；這個逐脈衝相位滑移在頻域上把整排梳齒平移了 f_ceo = f_rep·Δφ_ce/(2π)，於是第 n 根梳齒的頻率為 f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo。只要兩個射頻量 f_rep 與 f_ceo 被鎖定，數十萬根光學頻率的梳齒就全部被鎖定，這就是頻率梳把光頻與射頻連接起來的原理。~A mode-locked laser emits one pulse every T_rep = 1/f_rep, and a periodic pulse train in time is a row of lines spaced f_rep in frequency. Inside each pulse, however, the carrier slips by a phase Δφ_ce relative to the envelope from pulse to pulse because group and phase velocities in the cavity differ; in the frequency domain this per-pulse slip shifts the whole row by f_ceo = f_rep·Δφ_ce/(2π), so the n-th tooth sits at f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo. Locking the two radio frequencies f_rep and f_ceo locks all several hundred thousand optical teeth at once, which is how a comb links optical and radio frequencies.
units.model: 取 f_rep = 250 MHz、f_ceo = 20 MHz（教學假設）。1550 nm 對應 f = c/λ = 193.41 THz，梳齒序數 n = 193.41×10¹²/250×10⁶ ≈ 773,658；逐脈衝載波包絡相位滑移 Δφ_ce = 2π·f_ceo/f_rep = 2π×20/250 = 0.503 rad，即每 12.5 個脈衝載波相位轉滿一圈。光譜中相鄰梳齒間距 250 MHz 相當於 1550 nm 處 2.0 pm 的波長間隔。~Take f_rep = 250 MHz and f_ceo = 20 MHz (teaching assumptions). At 1550 nm, f = c/λ = 193.41 THz and the mode number is n = 193.41×10¹²/250×10⁶ ≈ 773,658; the per-pulse carrier-envelope slip is Δφ_ce = 2π·f_ceo/f_rep = 2π×20/250 = 0.503 rad, so the carrier phase completes one turn every 12.5 pulses. The 250 MHz tooth spacing corresponds to a 2.0 pm wavelength interval at 1550 nm.
units.verify: 用高速光二極體與頻譜分析儀觀察脈衝串，確認 f_rep 的基頻與諧波乾淨、無次諧波（表示單脈衝運轉）；再以 1 GHz 解析度的光譜儀確認光譜為平滑包絡而非多波長競爭。f_rep 以計數器對氫邁射計數，記錄自由運轉的漂移速率作為後續伺服設計的輸入。~Observe the pulse train with a fast photodiode and spectrum analyser, confirming a clean f_rep fundamental and harmonics without sub-harmonics (single-pulse operation); then check with an optical spectrum analyser at 1 GHz resolution that the spectrum is a smooth envelope rather than competing wavelengths. Count f_rep against a hydrogen maser and record the free-running drift rate as input to the servo design.
units.failure: 雷射進入多脈衝或 Q 切換鎖模狀態，f_rep 頻譜出現邊帶與次諧波，梳齒不再是單一等間距序列，後續的 f_ceo 拍頻消失，整套穩頻系統無從啟動。~If the laser slips into multi-pulse or Q-switched mode locking, the f_rep spectrum shows sidebands and sub-harmonics, the teeth are no longer one equally spaced series, the f_ceo beat vanishes and the stabilization chain cannot start.
units.misconception: 鎖定 f_rep 就等於鎖定了所有梳齒的絕對頻率。~Locking f_rep alone fixes the absolute frequency of every tooth.

units.anchor: f-2f 干涉儀與 f_ceo 拍頻~f-2f interferometer and the f_ceo beat
units.title: 倍頻程光譜與 f-2f 自參考~Octave-spanning spectrum and f-2f self-referencing
units.mechanism: f_ceo 無法直接從光譜讀出，必須用自參考法：先用高非線性光纖把光譜展寬到一個倍頻程，再把低頻端的梳齒 f_n 以 PPLN 晶體倍頻得到 2f_n = 2n·f_rep + 2f_ceo，與高頻端的梳齒 f_2n = 2n·f_rep + f_ceo 在同一個光二極體上拍頻，差頻正好是 f_ceo。這個拍頻訊號的訊雜比決定鎖相能否持續：業界經驗是 100 kHz 解析頻寬下至少 30 dB。f_ceo 的自由運轉線寬在摻鉺光纖梳約為數十到數百 kHz，由泵浦強度雜訊與腔內非線性相位轉換而來。~f_ceo cannot be read from the spectrum directly and needs self-referencing: a highly nonlinear fibre broadens the spectrum to an octave, the low-frequency tooth f_n is frequency-doubled in a PPLN crystal to 2f_n = 2n·f_rep + 2f_ceo, and this beats on one photodiode with the high-frequency tooth f_2n = 2n·f_rep + f_ceo, the difference being exactly f_ceo. The signal-to-noise ratio of this beat decides whether a phase lock can hold: industry practice asks for at least 30 dB in a 100 kHz resolution bandwidth. The free-running f_ceo linewidth of an erbium comb is tens to hundreds of kilohertz, produced by pump intensity noise converted through the intracavity nonlinear phase.
units.model: 摻鉺梳的超連續光譜涵蓋約 1000–2200 nm。取 2100 nm 端：f = 142.76 THz，n = 142.76×10¹²/250×10⁶ ≈ 571,033；倍頻後 285.5 THz（1050 nm），與序數 2n = 1,142,066 的梳齒拍頻：2(n·f_rep + f_ceo) − (2n·f_rep + f_ceo) = f_ceo = 20 MHz。若 f_ceo 自由運轉線寬 100 kHz，鎖相迴路頻寬必須大於此值的數倍，故 f_ceo 伺服常設計在 200–300 kHz。~The erbium comb's supercontinuum spans roughly 1000–2200 nm. At the 2100 nm end, f = 142.76 THz and n = 142.76×10¹²/250×10⁶ ≈ 571,033; after doubling, 285.5 THz (1050 nm) beats with the tooth of number 2n = 1,142,066: 2(n·f_rep + f_ceo) − (2n·f_rep + f_ceo) = f_ceo = 20 MHz. With a free-running f_ceo linewidth of 100 kHz the phase-lock bandwidth must exceed it several times over, so the f_ceo servo is usually designed for 200–300 kHz.
units.verify: 在頻譜分析儀上以 100 kHz 解析頻寬看 f_ceo 拍頻，確認訊雜比 ≥ 30 dB 且在 f_rep − f_ceo 處有鏡像拍頻；調整 PPLN 溫度（相位匹配）與 f-2f 干涉儀兩臂的延遲，使拍頻最大化；改變泵浦電流 1 mA 並記錄 f_ceo 的移動，得到伺服所需的致動係數。~View the f_ceo beat on a spectrum analyser at 100 kHz resolution bandwidth, confirming SNR ≥ 30 dB and the mirror beat at f_rep − f_ceo; tune the PPLN temperature (phase matching) and the delay between the two f-2f arms to maximise the beat; change the pump current by 1 mA and record the f_ceo shift to obtain the actuator coefficient needed by the servo.
units.failure: 高非線性光纖的色散或輸入脈衝能量不對，超連續光譜在 1050 nm 或 2100 nm 端的功率譜密度太低，f_ceo 拍頻只有 15 dB，鎖相每幾分鐘就滑脫一次，計數結果全部無效。~Wrong dispersion in the highly nonlinear fibre or wrong input pulse energy leaves too little spectral power density at the 1050 nm or 2100 nm end, the f_ceo beat reaches only 15 dB, the phase lock slips every few minutes and every counted result is invalid.
units.misconception: 只要光譜看起來夠寬，f-2f 拍頻就一定足夠強。~If the spectrum looks wide enough, the f-2f beat will automatically be strong enough.

units.anchor: 摻鉺振盪器、EDFA、HNLF 與 PPLN~Er oscillator, EDFA, HNLF and PPLN
units.title: 光纖梳的元件鏈與致動器~The fibre comb's component chain and actuators
units.mechanism: 摻鉺光纖振盪器（非線性偏振旋轉或 SESAM 鎖模）產生 250 MHz、數十 fs 的脈衝，經 EDFA 放大到數百 mW 後送入色散設計過的高非線性光纖產生超連續，再以 PPLN 倍頻。穩頻需要三類致動器：貼在光纖或腔鏡上的壓電致動器改變腔長以控制 f_rep（範圍數 kHz、頻寬數十 kHz）；腔內電光調制器提供 MHz 等級頻寬但只有 Hz 等級範圍；泵浦二極體電流透過腔內功率改變非線性相位來控制 f_ceo，頻寬受鉺增益動態限制在約 100 kHz；溫度或步進馬達平台則補償長期漂移。~An erbium fibre oscillator (nonlinear polarization rotation or SESAM mode locking) produces 250 MHz pulses of tens of femtoseconds, an EDFA amplifies them to a few hundred milliwatts, a dispersion-engineered highly nonlinear fibre generates the supercontinuum and a PPLN doubles it. Stabilization needs three classes of actuator: a piezo on the fibre or a cavity mirror changes cavity length to control f_rep (range of a few kHz, bandwidth of tens of kHz); an intracavity electro-optic modulator offers megahertz bandwidth but only hertz-level range; the pump-diode current controls f_ceo through the intracavity-power-dependent nonlinear phase with a bandwidth limited by erbium gain dynamics to about 100 kHz; temperature or a stepper stage absorbs long-term drift.
units.model: 250 MHz 的腔光學長度 L = c/f_rep = 1.2 m（光纖物理長度約 0.82 m）。壓電致動器行程 10 µm 時 Δf_rep = f_rep·ΔL/L = 250×10⁶×10×10⁻⁶/1.2 = 2083 Hz；對序數 773,658 的梳齒，光頻移動 n·Δf_rep = 773,658×2083 Hz ≈ 1.61 GHz。這個「槓桿」表示 f_rep 的 1 Hz 變化在 1550 nm 等於 774 kHz，所以 f_rep 伺服的精度要求比 f_ceo 嚴格六個數量級。~A 250 MHz cavity has optical length L = c/f_rep = 1.2 m (about 0.82 m of physical fibre). A piezo stroke of 10 µm gives Δf_rep = f_rep·ΔL/L = 250×10⁶×10×10⁻⁶/1.2 = 2083 Hz; for tooth number 773,658 the optical frequency moves by n·Δf_rep = 773,658×2083 Hz ≈ 1.61 GHz. This lever means a 1 Hz change of f_rep equals 774 kHz at 1550 nm, so the f_rep servo precision requirement is six orders of magnitude tighter than that for f_ceo.
units.verify: 對每個致動器量轉移函數：以網路分析儀從 1 Hz 掃到 1 MHz，記錄 f_rep 或 f_ceo 對驅動的響應幅度與相位，標出壓電機械共振與泵浦電流的增益滾降頻率；確認壓電行程換算的 Δf_rep 與 2083 Hz 的估計相符，並確認 EOM 的範圍與頻寬能覆蓋壓電共振以上的頻段。~Measure each actuator's transfer function with a network analyser swept from 1 Hz to 1 MHz, recording the amplitude and phase of f_rep or f_ceo against drive, marking the piezo mechanical resonance and the pump-current gain roll-off; confirm that the piezo stroke converts to a Δf_rep consistent with the 2083 Hz estimate and that the EOM's range and bandwidth cover the band above the piezo resonance.
units.failure: 壓電致動器的機械共振在 20 kHz 且未加陷波濾波，伺服增益提高時迴路在共振處振盪，f_rep 出現 20 kHz 邊帶，所有梳齒被調制成多條線，光頻量測出現數百 kHz 的假偏移。~A piezo with a 20 kHz mechanical resonance and no notch filter oscillates at the resonance when servo gain is raised, f_rep acquires 20 kHz sidebands, every tooth splits into several lines and optical-frequency measurements show spurious offsets of hundreds of kilohertz.
units.misconception: 一個行程夠大的壓電致動器就能同時處理 f_rep 的快速雜訊與慢速漂移。~One piezo with enough stroke can handle both the fast noise and the slow drift of f_rep.

units.anchor: f_rep／f_ceo 鎖相迴路與參考源~f_rep/f_ceo phase-locked loops and references
units.title: 鎖相架構：射頻參考與光學參考的槓桿~Lock architecture: the lever of RF versus optical references
units.mechanism: 兩個迴路各自把一個拍頻與合成器輸出的相位差送入 PID 控制器：f_ceo 迴路驅動泵浦電流，f_rep 迴路驅動壓電與 EOM。參考源有兩種選擇：射頻參考（氫邁射或銫鐘）把 f_rep 直接鎖到 10 MHz 的倍頻鏈上，但 f_rep 的相位雜訊會被乘上 n² 的功率比例傳到光頻；光學參考則把某一根梳齒與腔穩頻的連續波雷射拍頻鎖定，光頻的穩定度由參考雷射決定，再把 f_rep 當作輸出而非輸入。現代光鐘系統幾乎都用後者，射頻參考只用來計數與提供長期準確度。~Each loop feeds the phase difference between a beat and a synthesizer output into a PID controller: the f_ceo loop drives the pump current, the f_rep loop drives piezo and EOM. Two kinds of reference exist: an RF reference (hydrogen maser or caesium clock) locks f_rep to a multiplied 10 MHz chain, but the f_rep phase noise is transferred to the optical teeth multiplied by n² in power; an optical reference locks the beat between one tooth and a cavity-stabilised cw laser, the optical stability is set by that laser and f_rep becomes an output rather than an input. Modern optical-clock systems almost always use the latter, keeping the RF reference for counting and long-term accuracy.
units.model: 相位雜訊的槓桿為 20·log₁₀(n) = 20·log₁₀(773,658) = 117.8 dB：f_rep 在偏移 1 kHz 處 −150 dBc/Hz 的雜訊，在 193 THz 的梳齒上變成 −32 dBc/Hz。氫邁射 1 s 穩定度 1×10⁻¹³ 對應光頻不確定度 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz；改用 1×10⁻¹⁵ 的腔穩頻雷射作光學參考，1 s 的光頻不確定度降到 0.19 Hz，此時 f_rep 的 1 s 穩定度 = 1×10⁻¹⁵，遠優於任何射頻源。~The phase-noise lever is 20·log₁₀(n) = 20·log₁₀(773,658) = 117.8 dB: f_rep noise of −150 dBc/Hz at 1 kHz offset becomes −32 dBc/Hz on the 193 THz tooth. A hydrogen maser at 1×10⁻¹³ in 1 s corresponds to an optical uncertainty of 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz; switching to a 1×10⁻¹⁵ cavity-stabilised laser as optical reference lowers the 1 s optical uncertainty to 0.19 Hz, and f_rep then inherits 1×10⁻¹⁵ at 1 s, far better than any RF source.
units.verify: 鎖定後用第二台頻譜分析儀看迴路內誤差訊號的相位雜訊譜，確認伺服凸峰（servo bump）位置與設計頻寬一致且凸峰高度低於 10 dB；再把同一支連續波雷射與梳齒的拍頻送到迴路外的計數器，比較迴路內與迴路外的艾倫偏差，兩者的差異就是未被伺服看見的路徑雜訊。~After locking, examine the in-loop error signal's phase-noise spectrum on a second analyser, confirming that the servo bump sits at the designed bandwidth and is lower than 10 dB; then send the beat between the same cw laser and the comb to an out-of-loop counter and compare in-loop and out-of-loop Allan deviations, their difference being the path noise the servo never sees.
units.failure: 以 10 MHz 石英振盪器當 f_rep 參考並直接倍頻，117.8 dB 的槓桿把石英的相位雜訊放大，193 THz 梳齒的線寬達數百 kHz，與任何窄線寬雷射的拍頻都無法計數。~Using a 10 MHz quartz oscillator as the f_rep reference and multiplying it directly lets the 117.8 dB lever amplify the quartz phase noise, the 193 THz teeth acquire linewidths of hundreds of kilohertz and the beat with any narrow-linewidth laser cannot be counted.
units.misconception: 只要射頻參考夠好，用射頻鎖定的頻率梳在光頻就和光學參考一樣穩定。~With a good enough RF reference, an RF-locked comb is as stable at optical frequencies as an optically referenced one.

units.anchor: 梳齒序數 n 與符號判定~Mode number n and sign determination
units.title: 絕對光頻量測：序數、符號與計數~Absolute optical-frequency measurement: mode number, signs and counting
units.mechanism: 量測一支連續波雷射的絕對頻率時，f_cw = n·f_rep ± f_ceo ± f_beat，四種符號組合與序數 n 都要被判定。序數靠波長計：只要波長計的準確度優於 f_rep/2，就能唯一指定 n；符號靠擾動：把 f_rep 略微提高，若拍頻隨之下降則 f_cw 在梳齒之上，再把 f_ceo 鎖定點改變看拍頻方向就能定第二個符號。計數時用無死區的計數器，並以兩台計數器（不同閘門時間或相位記錄模式）平行計數偵測週期滑脫。~To measure a cw laser's absolute frequency, f_cw = n·f_rep ± f_ceo ± f_beat, and both the mode number n and the four sign combinations must be determined. The mode number comes from a wavemeter: an accuracy better than f_rep/2 assigns n uniquely; the signs come from perturbation: raise f_rep slightly and if the beat falls the laser lies above the tooth, then change the f_ceo lock point and watch the beat direction to fix the second sign. Counting uses dead-time-free counters, and two counters run in parallel (different gate times or phase-recording mode) to detect cycle slips.
units.model: f_rep 改變 +1.000 Hz 時，第 773,658 根梳齒移動 773,658 Hz = 773.66 kHz；拍頻由 35.000 MHz 變為 34.226 MHz 就表示 f_cw 高於梳齒、且 n 可由位移量除以 1 Hz 直接核對。波長計準確度需 < f_rep/2 = 125 MHz，相當於 1550 nm 處 1 pm；商用波長計 ±30 MHz 足夠。單次計數閘門 1 s 時，一次 2π 的週期滑脫 = 1 Hz 誤差 = 193.41 THz 的 5.2×10⁻¹⁵，比梳本身 10⁻¹⁶ 的貢獻大 50 倍。~Changing f_rep by +1.000 Hz moves tooth 773,658 by 773,658 Hz = 773.66 kHz; if the beat goes from 35.000 MHz to 34.226 MHz the laser lies above the tooth, and n is checked directly as the shift divided by 1 Hz. The wavemeter accuracy must be < f_rep/2 = 125 MHz, about 1 pm at 1550 nm, so a commercial ±30 MHz wavemeter suffices. With a 1 s counting gate, one 2π cycle slip equals a 1 Hz error, 5.2×10⁻¹⁵ of 193.41 THz, fifty times larger than the comb's own 10⁻¹⁶ contribution.
units.verify: 用一支已知頻率的參考（例如鎖在乙炔或銣吸收線上的雷射，或另一台獨立頻率梳）做盲測：以上述程序判定 n 與符號並計數 1000 s，結果應落在參考值的不確定度內；同時比較兩台計數器的讀值，任何一秒的差異 ≥ 1 Hz 就標記為週期滑脫並剔除。~Run a blind test with a reference of known frequency (a laser locked to an acetylene or rubidium line, or a second independent comb): determine n and the signs by the procedure above, count for 1000 s and confirm the result lies within the reference's uncertainty; compare the two counters' readings throughout and flag any second differing by ≥ 1 Hz as a cycle slip to be discarded.
units.failure: 波長計未校正、偏了 200 MHz，序數 n 被指定錯一根，絕對頻率報告值偏差整整 250 MHz，卻因為拍頻計數穩定而無人察覺。~An uncalibrated wavemeter off by 200 MHz assigns the mode number one tooth wrong, the reported absolute frequency is off by a full 250 MHz, and nobody notices because the beat counts are perfectly stable.
units.misconception: 拍頻計數穩定就代表絕對頻率正確。~A stable beat count proves the absolute frequency is right.

units.anchor: 雙梳比對與艾倫偏差~Comb-versus-comb comparison and Allan deviation
units.title: 殘餘雜訊、週期滑脫與誤差預算~Residual noise, cycle slips and the error budget
units.mechanism: 頻率梳作為「齒輪」本身引入的誤差要用兩台獨立梳鎖到同一光學參考、再比較它們在另一波長的梳齒來評估；得到的艾倫偏差隨平均時間以 1/τ 下降（相位鎖定的白相位雜訊特性），而不是 1/√τ。誤差預算包含：迴路外路徑（光纖、放大器）的相位漂移、f_ceo 拍頻訊雜比不足造成的週期滑脫、參考源的傳遞、偏振與功率相關的拍頻偏移，以及計數器的閘門同步。只有把這些逐項量化，梳才能支撐 10⁻¹⁸ 等級的光鐘比對。~The error a comb itself introduces as a gear is evaluated by locking two independent combs to the same optical reference and comparing their teeth at another wavelength; the resulting Allan deviation falls as 1/τ with averaging time (the white-phase-noise signature of a phase lock), not as 1/√τ. The budget includes phase drift of out-of-loop paths (fibres, amplifiers), cycle slips from insufficient f_ceo beat SNR, transfer of the reference, polarization- and power-dependent beat offsets, and counter gate synchronisation. Only when each is quantified can a comb support optical-clock comparisons at the 10⁻¹⁸ level.
units.model: 雙梳比對的典型結果（教學假設）：σ_y(1 s) = 2×10⁻¹⁶，以 1/τ 平均，σ_y(1000 s) = 2×10⁻¹⁹。若每小時發生一次未偵測的週期滑脫（1 Hz 誤差持續 1 s），對 3600 s 平均的貢獻為 5.2×10⁻¹⁵/3600 = 1.4×10⁻¹⁸，已與 1000 s 的梳雜訊同量級，所以滑脫偵測與剔除是預算的必要項目。~A typical comb-versus-comb result (teaching assumption) is σ_y(1 s) = 2×10⁻¹⁶ averaging as 1/τ, giving σ_y(1000 s) = 2×10⁻¹⁹. If one undetected cycle slip per hour occurs (a 1 Hz error lasting 1 s), its contribution to a 3600 s average is 5.2×10⁻¹⁵/3600 = 1.4×10⁻¹⁸, already comparable to the comb noise at 1000 s, so slip detection and rejection are a mandatory budget item.
units.verify: 把兩台梳鎖到同一支 1542 nm 超穩雷射，各自在 1064 nm 取一根梳齒拍頻並計數 10⁴ s，計算艾倫偏差並確認斜率為 −1；把功率改變 ±3 dB、偏振旋轉 10°，記錄拍頻中心是否移動 > 1 mHz，以此量化功率與偏振相關偏移。~Lock two combs to the same 1542 nm ultrastable laser, beat one tooth of each at 1064 nm, count for 10⁴ s, compute the Allan deviation and confirm a slope of −1; change the power by ±3 dB and rotate the polarization by 10° and record whether the beat centre moves by more than 1 mHz, quantifying power- and polarization-dependent offsets.
units.failure: 梳輸出經過 20 m 未補償的光纖送到光鐘實驗室，實驗室空調的溫度循環在光纖上造成每 10 分鐘數百 rad 的相位漂移，比對結果在 100–1000 s 出現平台，被誤判為光鐘本身的不穩定。~Sending the comb output through 20 m of uncompensated fibre to the clock laboratory lets the air-conditioning temperature cycle impose hundreds of radians of phase drift every 10 minutes, the comparison shows a plateau at 100–1000 s and the clock itself is wrongly blamed.
units.misconception: 鎖相迴路內的誤差訊號很小，就表示梳的輸出在使用端同樣乾淨。~A small in-loop error signal means the comb output is equally clean where it is used.

units.anchor: 熱漂移、致動器範圍與光纖雜訊消除~Thermal drift, actuator range and fibre-noise cancellation
units.title: 系統整合：環境、致動器分配與傳輸~System integration: environment, actuator allocation and delivery
units.mechanism: 全天候運轉的關鍵是把雜訊按頻段分配給正確的致動器，並讓環境漂移不耗盡任何一個致動器的範圍：EOM 處理 10 kHz 以上、壓電處理 1 Hz–10 kHz、步進平台或溫控處理更慢的漂移，各迴路之間以積分器「卸載」（offloading）把慢速累積交給大範圍致動器。光纖的熱光係數使腔長隨溫度變化，必須用隔熱與溫控外殼壓低；梳光送到他處使用時，傳輸光纖的相位雜訊以往返干涉法主動消除。偏振、泵浦功率與 EDFA 增益都要有監控點。~Round-the-clock operation hinges on assigning noise bands to the right actuators and keeping environmental drift from exhausting any actuator's range: the EOM handles above 10 kHz, the piezo 1 Hz to 10 kHz, and a stepper stage or temperature control the slower drift, with integrators offloading slow accumulation from fast actuators to the large-range ones. The thermo-optic coefficient of fibre makes cavity length track temperature, which insulation and a temperature-controlled housing must suppress; when comb light is delivered elsewhere, the phase noise of the transport fibre is cancelled actively with a round-trip interferometer. Polarization, pump power and EDFA gain all need monitoring points.
units.model: 矽光纖的有效光程溫度係數約 7.4×10⁻⁶/K（熱光 6.9×10⁻⁶ 加熱膨脹 0.55×10⁻⁶），故 Δf_rep/ΔT = 250×10⁶×7.4×10⁻⁶ = 1850 Hz/K。第 3 單元的壓電範圍 ±1042 Hz 只能吸收 ±0.56 K；若外殼溫控到 ±0.1 K，漂移 ±185 Hz，佔壓電範圍 18%，其餘留給聲學與氣壓擾動；超過 ±0.3 K 就必須由步進平台卸載。~Silica fibre's effective optical-path temperature coefficient is about 7.4×10⁻⁶/K (thermo-optic 6.9×10⁻⁶ plus expansion 0.55×10⁻⁶), so Δf_rep/ΔT = 250×10⁶×7.4×10⁻⁶ = 1850 Hz/K. The ±1042 Hz piezo range of unit 3 absorbs only ±0.56 K; with the housing controlled to ±0.1 K the drift is ±185 Hz, 18% of the piezo range, leaving the rest for acoustic and pressure disturbances; beyond ±0.3 K the stepper stage must offload.
units.verify: 記錄 24 小時的壓電驅動電壓、步進平台位置、外殼溫度與氣壓，畫成時間序列：壓電電壓應在範圍中央 ±30% 內擺動且與溫度無長期相關；若卸載正常，步進平台的位置曲線應與溫度曲線同形。對傳輸光纖，用往返拍頻量測開啟與關閉消除時的艾倫偏差，確認關閉時 1 s 的 10⁻¹⁴ 等級雜訊被壓到 10⁻¹⁷ 以下。~Log 24 hours of piezo drive voltage, stepper position, housing temperature and barometric pressure as time series: the piezo voltage should swing within ±30% of mid-range with no long-term correlation with temperature, and with offloading working the stepper position should mirror the temperature curve. For the transport fibre, measure the round-trip beat's Allan deviation with cancellation on and off, confirming that the 10⁻¹⁴-level 1 s noise when off is pushed below 10⁻¹⁷ when on.
units.failure: 實驗室夜間空調停機，溫度漂移 2 K 使 f_rep 漂移 3.7 kHz，壓電在凌晨兩點到達行程極限而失鎖；次日早上發現整夜的光鐘比對資料只剩四小時有效。~The laboratory air-conditioning stops overnight, a 2 K drift moves f_rep by 3.7 kHz, the piezo hits its stroke limit at two in the morning and the lock is lost; next morning only four hours of the overnight clock comparison turn out to be valid.
units.misconception: 只要鎖相迴路頻寬夠大，環境溫度變化就不會造成失鎖。~With enough servo bandwidth, environmental temperature changes can never cause loss of lock.

units.anchor: 鎖定品質報告與全天候驗證~Lock-quality record and round-the-clock validation
units.title: 鎖定品質、驗收準則與工程交接~Lock quality, acceptance criteria and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 頻率梳的驗收不是「有拍頻就好」，而是用可量化的指標：殘餘相位雜訊積分值（決定多少功率在相干載波中）、f_ceo 與 f_rep 拍頻訊雜比、迴路外艾倫偏差、週期滑脫率、連續鎖定時數與自動重鎖能力。交接文件應包含每個致動器的轉移函數、伺服參數、鎖定點、所有拍頻的頻率與符號約定、波長計校正值、以及環境監測的正常範圍，讓接手者能在不重新摸索的情況下判斷系統是否仍處於驗收狀態。~Accepting a comb is not a matter of seeing a beat but of quantified indicators: the integrated residual phase noise (which sets how much power sits in the coherent carrier), the SNR of the f_ceo and f_rep beats, out-of-loop Allan deviation, cycle-slip rate, continuous lock time and automatic relock capability. The handoff file should contain each actuator's transfer function, servo parameters, lock points, the frequency and sign convention of every beat, the wavemeter calibration value and the normal range of every environmental monitor, so the next engineer can judge whether the system is still in its accepted state without rediscovering it.
units.model: 把 f_ceo 迴路的殘餘相位雜訊從 1 Hz 積分到 1 MHz 得 σ_φ = 0.3 rad（教學假設），相干載波功率比例 = exp(−σ_φ²) = exp(−0.09) = 0.91，即 91% 的功率在載波、9% 在雜訊基座；若 σ_φ 升到 1 rad，比例掉到 37%，拍頻看似仍在但計數開始跳動。驗收門檻常訂為 σ_φ ≤ 0.5 rad（載波 ≥ 78%）、24 小時內週期滑脫 0 次、拍頻訊雜比 ≥ 30 dB。~Integrating the f_ceo loop's residual phase noise from 1 Hz to 1 MHz gives σ_φ = 0.3 rad (teaching assumption), so the coherent-carrier fraction is exp(−σ_φ²) = exp(−0.09) = 0.91, i.e. 91% of the power in the carrier and 9% in the noise pedestal; at σ_φ = 1 rad the fraction drops to 37%, the beat still appears present but counts begin to jump. Typical acceptance thresholds are σ_φ ≤ 0.5 rad (carrier ≥ 78%), zero cycle slips in 24 hours and beat SNR ≥ 30 dB.
units.verify: 執行 24 小時驗收運轉：每秒記錄兩台計數器的 f_ceo、f_rep 與連續波拍頻、壓電電壓與溫度；驗收後統計滑脫次數、計算迴路外艾倫偏差、用頻譜分析儀的相位雜訊量測積分出 σ_φ，並把結果與門檻一起寫入交接報告；刻意拔除再接回參考訊號，確認自動重鎖在 10 秒內完成。~Run a 24 hour acceptance run logging, every second, the f_ceo, f_rep and cw beat readings of both counters together with piezo voltage and temperature; afterwards count the slips, compute the out-of-loop Allan deviation, integrate σ_φ from the spectrum analyser's phase-noise measurement, and enter the results with the thresholds in the handoff report; deliberately disconnect and reconnect the reference to confirm automatic relock within 10 seconds.
units.failure: 交接時只留下「正常可用」四個字與一組伺服設定值，沒有致動器轉移函數與符號約定；半年後更換泵浦二極體，f_ceo 致動係數反號，接手者把迴路接成正回授，花了兩週才找出為何永遠鎖不住。~The handoff leaves only the words works normally and one set of servo values, with no actuator transfer functions or sign conventions; six months later a pump diode is replaced, the f_ceo actuator coefficient changes sign, the successor wires the loop as positive feedback and spends two weeks discovering why it never locks.
units.misconception: 頻率梳是交鑰匙產品，開機鎖定後不需要任何驗收指標。~A frequency comb is a turnkey product that needs no acceptance metrics once it locks.

example: 頻率梳設計核對：摻鉺光纖梳 f_rep = 250 MHz，f_ceo 鎖在 20 MHz。1550 nm（193.41 THz）的梳齒序數 n = 773,658；一支 1550 nm 連續波雷射與該梳齒拍頻 35.000 MHz，把 f_rep 提高 1.000 Hz 後拍頻變為 34.226 MHz（移動 773.66 kHz），證明 f_cw 高於梳齒且 n 正確。射頻參考：氫邁射 1 s 穩定度 1×10⁻¹³ 使光頻不確定度 = 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz；改用 1×10⁻¹⁵ 的腔穩頻雷射作光學參考則為 0.19 Hz。致動器：10 µm 壓電行程在 1.2 m 光程上給 ±1042 Hz 的 f_rep 範圍，對應梳齒 ±0.81 GHz；熱漂移 1850 Hz/K 表示溫度變化 0.56 K 就耗盡壓電，故外殼溫控 ±0.1 K（±185 Hz）並用步進平台卸載。鎖定品質：殘餘相位雜訊 σ_φ = 0.3 rad → 相干載波 exp(−0.09) = 91%；每秒一次週期滑脫等於 1 Hz = 5.2×10⁻¹⁵，遠高於雙梳比對的 2×10⁻¹⁶（1 s）基準，因此需要雙計數器滑脫偵測。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。~Comb design check: an erbium fibre comb with f_rep = 250 MHz and f_ceo locked at 20 MHz. The tooth at 1550 nm (193.41 THz) has mode number n = 773,658; a 1550 nm cw laser beats with it at 35.000 MHz, and after raising f_rep by 1.000 Hz the beat becomes 34.226 MHz (a 773.66 kHz shift), proving that f_cw lies above the tooth and that n is right. RF reference: a hydrogen maser at 1×10⁻¹³ in 1 s gives an optical uncertainty of 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz; a 1×10⁻¹⁵ cavity-stabilised laser as optical reference gives 0.19 Hz. Actuators: a 10 µm piezo stroke on 1.2 m of optical path gives ±1042 Hz of f_rep range, ±0.81 GHz at the tooth; thermal drift of 1850 Hz/K means a 0.56 K change exhausts the piezo, so the housing is held to ±0.1 K (±185 Hz) and a stepper stage offloads. Lock quality: residual phase noise σ_φ = 0.3 rad → coherent carrier exp(−0.09) = 91%; one cycle slip per second equals 1 Hz = 5.2×10⁻¹⁵, far above the 2×10⁻¹⁶ (1 s) comb-versus-comb floor, hence dual-counter slip detection. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
history: 1999–2000 年間，Hänsch 在德國馬克斯普朗克量子光學研究所與 Hall 在美國 JILA 的團隊分別以鈦藍寶石鎖模雷射與微結構光纖實現自參考的光學頻率梳，把過去需要整個房間的諧波頻率鏈縮成一台雷射，兩人因此分享 2005 年諾貝爾物理獎。2001 年 Menlo Systems 作為 MPQ 衍生公司成立，2000 年代中期摻鉺光纖梳使頻率梳成為可全天候運轉的商用儀器；2007 年起微共振腔克爾梳開啟晶片化方向。今日頻率梳是光學原子鐘、精密光譜、天文光譜儀校正與光纖時頻傳遞的核心。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。~Between 1999 and 2000 the groups of Hänsch at the Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics in Germany and Hall at JILA in the United States realised self-referenced optical frequency combs with titanium-sapphire mode-locked lasers and microstructured fibre, shrinking harmonic frequency chains that once filled a room into a single laser, for which the two shared the 2005 Nobel Prize in Physics. Menlo Systems was founded in 2001 as an MPQ spin-off, erbium fibre combs in the mid-2000s turned the comb into a commercial instrument that runs around the clock, and from 2007 microresonator Kerr combs opened the chip-scale direction. Today combs are central to optical atomic clocks, precision spectroscopy, astronomical spectrograph calibration and fibre time-frequency transfer; this course reconstructs only public principles and engineering methods.
